cases.description: A reserved word of R cannot be a bare name.

cases.description: A number other than 0 or 1 cannot be a term.

cases.description: A decimal number.

cases.description: An exponent that is not a number.

issue.message: 'k' at byte 12 is not a valid number there. Only 0 and 1 can stand as terms, and an exponent is an integer from 2 to 1000.
